claims.head: The Stars will send Lindell and Heiskanen at Pastrňák
claims.call: The Stars’ P1 (Lindell and Heiskanen) spends at least 48% of its 5-on-5 time against the Bruins’ first line.
claims.body: At home, the Stars keep sending Lindell and Heiskanen out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Glen Gulutzan has been picking a defense pair for the other team’s top line. Tonight the Bruins’ first line is Pastrňák, Zacha and Geekie.

claims.head: In close against from distance
claims.body: On shots from in close, Dallas is one of the league’s best, but Boston is one of the worst. They’re about as far apart as two teams get. Shots from in close tend to be more dangerous, so expect the Stars to do more of their damage around the net.

notes.text: Jonathan Aspirot has not dressed for the last 5 games. He is one of their more valuable skaters. Frédéric Brunet has taken his spot beside Mason Lohrei.
Pavel Zacha is day to day, reported after he played in their last game. He is a top-six forward.
Wyatt Johnston is out (illness) and has missed the last 2 games. He is a top-six forward.
Matt Duchene is on long-term injured reserve (abdomen injury) and has not played this season. He is a top-six forward.

DAL.head: The Stars should have the upper hand
DAL.body: Even though Dallas will be without Johnston, the Stars have been out-chancing opponents lately and have home-ice advantage. The Bruins’ way back in is getting good looks.
